ideas.said: Let's buy XMR every time a major company gets hacked
ideas.label: Buy XMR on major hacks, hold 1d
verdict: No edge. XMR averaged -0.5% the day after a hack, +0.3% on any day. 12 of 26 were up.
As a rule since Nov 2024: -15.4%, worst drop 21.8%. Just holding XMR: +292.6%.

Only 6 days of price history (xyz:ANT listed Oct 26), so this is a snapshot, not evidence.

ideas.said: Dwarkesh is always right. Trade every new episode
ideas.label: Buy xyz:NVDA on each new Dwarkesh Podcast episode, hold 7d
ideas.why: Dwarkesh is always right, and he mostly talks about AI, so each new episode buys AI compute: xyz:NVDA for 7 days. This trades the release dates; it does not read what was said.
verdict: Some edge. xyz:NVDA averaged +1.3% over the 7 days after an episode, +0.3% on any day. 22 of 33 were up.
As a rule since Nov 12, 2025: +29.1%, worst drop 18.8%. Just holding xyz:NVDA: +6.0%.
